hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python3 production/coherence/coherence.py check 2>&1 | sed 's/^/[coherence] /' || true

_comment: Stop hook runs the coherence engine after every assistant turn. Output is prefixed with [coherence] and routed through `|| true` so it never blocks. To disable, remove the `Stop` block. To trigger manually: `python3 production/coherence/coherence.py check`.
